transcript_full: Since the 1st of November I haven't had anything to eat and I haven't put anything in my mouth except water or a few teaspoons of salt. I've lost eight and a half kilos already. I'm losing about half a kilo or a bit more a day but I'm willing to do this for as long as I can. I won't give up unless my body does or unless the Australian government make a commitment to real hard climate action. I quit working for the Australian government when I was Australia's ambassador to nine countries in West Africa including Senegal where I was expected to promote a massive oil and gas project owned by Woodside Energy and I realised that I couldn't live with myself. I couldn't do that and look my daughter and my son in the eye and that's why I quit and came back to Australia and that's another reason why I'm here on the lawns of Parliament House protesting for a safe future for Australia and our children. This is like COVID was it's an emergency it's a climate emergency and we need our leaders to act like it's an emergency.
